summary: @servicetitan/log-service 38.1.3 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from a GitHub releases URL (bun v1.3.13) into a temp directory when Bun is not already present, then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js at install time. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle with heavy string-array-shuffle obfuscation (rotator function over a large numeric/string array, hex-mangled _0x* identifiers) whose filename and contents are unrelated to the declared 'log-service to send events to Kibana' purpose and are not referenced from the legitimate dist/ TypeScript build. The tarball also ships a legitimate-looking dist/ tree and manifest metadata pointing at docs.st.dev and the servicetitan/uikit repository, but the upstream uikit log-service does not include a preinstall hook, setup.mjs, or math_init.js. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time and using it to execute an obfuscated bundled payload runs attacker-supplied code on the installer's machine outside Node's normal resolution and inspection path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
